name: Global Summary of the Month (GSOM)
description: The Global Summary of the Month (GSOM) dataset provides monthly climate summaries derived directly from the Global Historical Climatology Network daily (GHCN-Daily) station observations across the globe. Maintained by NOAA NCEI under DOI: 10.7289/V5QV3JJ5, GSOM computes monthly statistics including mean maximum temperature, mean minimum temperature, monthly average temperature, total monthly precipitation, total snowfall, and departure from normals for over 100,000 stations. Unlike GHCN-Monthly v4, GSOM represents direct arithmetic aggregations of daily records without historical homogenization.

publisher.name: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)

license.name: U.S. Government Work (17 U.S.C. 105) / Public Domain
license.notes: NOAA publishes GSOM under a U.S. Government Work public domain designation without copyright asserted by NOAA. However, because the underlying GHCN-Daily observations originate from international meteorological agencies, downstream users must not treat all separately sourced international observations as unconditionally free of rights restrictions worldwide.

provenance.collection_method: Automated monthly derivation from daily GHCN-Daily observations.
provenance.curation_notes: GSOM uses unhomogenized daily summations from GHCN-Daily, whereas GHCNm v4 applies pairwise homogenization algorithms. Distinct from GSOD, which is derived from ISD.
